text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Due to a mild sprain, Copano Rickey gave 
up on running in the Nihon Derby.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Instead, she appeared as a feng shui 
commentator on the live race broadcast. 
The race predictions she made based on 
feng shui turned out to be a massive hit.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Prompted by that prediction, a feng shui 
boom swept the nation. The dream of making 
everyone happy through feng shui rapidly 
began turning into reality.
